label: Supporting Artifact / Not a Source of Truth
title: verification-1 browser check (driven manually through a real browser, not an automated test)
how: npm run web:build, then npm run start:browser (one process on http://localhost:3220 serving the built SPA and the API, fresh embedded PostgreSQL). A test account generated for this run was used; its credentials are not recorded.

checks.name: Register from the SPA form -> redirected to /goals, header shows the signed-in email
document.cookie is empty after sign-in (session cookie is HttpOnly, not readable by script)
Create a goal, open /goals/:goalId, press Done -> the today view shows log: DONE
Full page reload on the deep route /goals/:goalId keeps the session and renders the route (server fallback to index.html)
Sign out -> shows signed out; visiting /goals then shows the 401 message and the API returns 401
Sign in again with the same account -> /goals lists the goal created before

notRun: Mobile width, other browsers, cookie-blocking modes
